about: The section 34 release-acceptance checklist (north-star amendment A26). A version tag that is not a beta (vX.Y.Z-beta.N) is refused unless every row is pass with its evidence, or is exempted by the amendment scripts/release_acceptance.py allows for it (A10 deferred, A11 moved, A12 removed). verified_for names the version the results were recorded for. Betas are exempt (A19).

rows.requirement: Stable release requires evidence of install, use, update, restore, governance on representative machines

CI: tests run 40076304478 on main df2872452.

Same step 'Run unit + API suites' runs pytest tests/api in tests.yml; release_gate.py (installer.yml tests-green job and publish step) refuses a tag unless tests.yml is green, tested by tests/unit/test_release_waits_for_green_tests.py. CI: tests run 40076304478 on main df2872452.
